Hi Neelesh,

Thank you for coming back to me, and I'm sorry the wait on the B30 pushed you to this.

Before anything else, one thing you should know: your unit is in Batch 1 and the ship date on your order is October 15, so it is right at the front of the queue now rather than months out. If you'd rather hold on after all, just say so and I'll make sure nothing moves.

If you do still want to cancel, your request is now with a supervisor for review. They start at 10am Eastern today and will come back to you directly on this thread to confirm. I'm not able to process the cancellation or the refund myself, so I don't want to quote you an amount or a date and have it be wrong.

Sorry again for the delay on this one.

Regards,
Sarah H.

Hello Sarah.I'm glad you can understand my frustration from my original mid July 2026 order and delays.I agree to your offer of a $100 credit to my original payment and await delivery of the B30 unit.Regards,Neelesh J.
Handed to the team · $100 refund to original payment needs a person; offered in writing in this threa

Hi Neelesh,

Thank you, that is noted and I'm glad we landed somewhere that works for you.

So we are both clear on what happens next: your B30 order stays exactly as it is, Batch 1 is on its way to our Canadian warehouse, and your unit ships to you from Brampton as soon as that batch lands and is checked in. Your Power Kit is on the order too and ships with it. You can follow that incoming batch here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

On the $100, that is money going back to the card you paid with, and a colleague processes it from their side rather than mine. They pick it up today at 10am Eastern and you will get the confirmation by email once it is sent. Card refunds then take 3 to 5 business days to show on your statement.

Thank you again for sticking with us on this one, Neelesh.

Best regards,
Sarah H.
